notes: Machine-owned continuity fallback for the exact first governed Base validation lineage.
No resident heartbeat completion dependency is required.
When an authorized same-host TV/TVC Unix broker socket is present, v3 consumes that canonical transport directly and does not require the HTTPS primary-runtime observer receipt first.
When no same-host Unix broker is present, v3 delegates unchanged to the existing v2/primary-runtime-observer path.
Broker endpoint is non-secret configuration; all provider secret/token authority remains TV/TVC/vault-only.
No GitHub token, provider API key, wallet credential, signing credential or cloud credential is allowlisted.
Worker retains exact validated TVC source checks before pretrade execution.
The same-host socket is exercised by run_continuity_pretrade.py; an unavailable or invalid broker fails closed rather than becoming readiness evidence.
Worker acquires a collision-safe continuity claim and yields if resident StegFin execution already owns the lineage.
Wrapper releases only a claim owned by the same worker instance after BLOCKED/FAILED/REVIEW_REQUIRED/COMPLETE terminal outcomes, preventing stale self-owned continuity claims from suppressing retry.
Stops at USER_ONLY wallet handoff with signed=false and broadcast=false.
